title: Near-Optimal Mode Scaling for Finite-Dimensional Boson Sampling via Lie-Algebraic Leakage Bounds
summary: Boson sampling demonstrates quantum advantage through the interference of indistinguishable particles, with output probabilities governed by matrix permanents. Realizing it on deterministic, matter-based platforms requires encoding the bosonic modes in finite-dimensional local Hilbert spaces, which introduces a leakage channel absent in linear optics: multi-particle bunching beyond the local truncation $d$.
